verdict.rationale: stagewise's own docs show agents editing files across several workspaces at once and running multi-step workflows. The Diff Review page lists every modified file, and a single action can roll back all changes from one agent run. That is real multi-item operation, but bulk operation is not documented as a dedicated feature. missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation capability (e.g., accept-all or batch apply across items), documented limits or scale for multi-item operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces
For changes across multiple files, open the dedicated Diff Review page. It provides: A scrollable list of every modified file
Undo — Roll back all changes from a specific agent action.
Connect several project folders at once so agents can work across your full stack
